detail.name: Lighter
detail.public_notice: A market maker associated with Lighter experienced a private key compromise. The Lighter protocol itself was unaffected by this incident. All deposits and withdrawals have resumed. For more information, please view this announcement on X.

description.en: Lighter is a decentralized trading platform built for unmatched security and scale. It’s the first exchange to offer verifiable order matching and liquidations while delivering best-in-class performance on par with traditional exchanges.
